name: license-card-issue
intent: Blank credential constructs through photo frame, data lines, and VALID seal stamp.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Full card appears immediately without staged photo/data/seal construction

acceptance: Idle: blank card slot; polite live region reads blank credential
ISSUE: photo frame pops in (320ms), then three data lines slide in (400ms staggered)
Seal phase: octagonal outer + circular ring stamp VALID with impact overshoot (400ms)
Done: ISSUE disabled; RESET shown; live announces provisional license issued
RESET clears card to idle and re-enables ISSUE
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) skips staged construction
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: Credential field strings and VALID seal geometry (octagon + ring) frozen in contract
